records.name: Stummheld Trotzdem
records.biography_en: Can explain a catastrophe silently but cannot get a word into the meeting. His HyperNorm cane rehearses a disaster nobody is permitted to call a disaster. A dissonant card understands the gesture without requiring the official caption. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Erklärung erfolgt stumm und bleibt dennoch unterbrochen.

variant_notes.note_en: Can explain a catastrophe silently but cannot get a word into the meeting.

records.name: Regisseurin Nochneklappe
records.biography_en: Knows exactly what she wants once she has seen what everybody did wrong. Her HyperNorm clapboard separates usable reactions from another take. A dissonant card asks whether anyone was listening before the performance began. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Absicht wird nach Sichtung der Ausführung präzisiert.

variant_notes.note_en: Knows exactly what she wants once she has seen what everybody did wrong.

records.name: Kritiker Popcornurteil
records.biography_en: Finds the ending predictable after patiently waiting to see it. His HyperNorm popcorn marks the time spent waiting to dislike an ending. A dissonant card offers a scene that refuses to conclude. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Urteil wurde bis zum erwartbaren Schluss zurückgehalten.

variant_notes.note_en: Finds the ending predictable after patiently waiting to see it.

records.name: Double Zweimalgut
records.biography_en: Has the same job twice and remains unsure which version gets the credit. His matching HyperNorm caps prove that either version can be replaced. A dissonant card asks which one was allowed to get frightened. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Vertretung vertritt vorsorglich auch ihre Vertretung.

variant_notes.note_en: Has the same job twice and remains unsure which version gets the credit.

records.name: Filmwart Schlingenschnitt
records.biography_en: Finds the missing scene curled around the explanation for its absence. His HyperNorm reel winds missing scenes into a tidy account of continuity. A dissonant card finds the splice everybody has agreed not to see. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der fehlende Zusammenhang wurde sauber aufgewickelt.

variant_notes.note_en: Finds the missing scene curled around the explanation for its absence.

records.name: Starlet Selbstlicht
records.biography_en: Has mastered the expression of being thrilled to be asked the same question. Her HyperNorm award confirms she is delighted to be here. A dissonant card notices the tired hand holding the shine in place. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Begeisterung ist bis zur nächsten Frage einsatzbereit.

variant_notes.note_en: Has mastered the expression of being thrilled to be asked the same question.
